extDescription.message: Adds bid/ask spread, chart range %, your orders on the chart and order filters to the DEGIRO web trader. Not affiliated with DEGIRO.
extDescription.description: Store summary, at most 132 characters; must say it is not affiliated with DEGIRO

optOnThisPage.description: Popup section: status of each feature on the open DEGIRO tab

optSpreadHelp.message: Spread row in Pricing data, colour-coded by size.

optHeaderSpreadHelp.message: Current spread % next to the price, e.g. “Spread 0,08%”.

optExDividendHelp.message: Shown after the spread when known; click to jump to Dividends.

optCompactHelp.message: Tighter spacing between all rows in Pricing data.

optPeriodChangeHelp.message: Next to the daily change on products and next to the total on the portfolio chart.

optChartSelectHelp.message: Drag on a product or portfolio chart to see the change between two points.

optOrdersChartHelp.message: Dashed line and badge at each order price.

optOrdersClickHelp.message: Opens DEGIRO's Adjust order form for that order.

optAdjustClose.message: Click outside or Esc closes Adjust order

optAdjustCloseHelp.message: Same as pressing Cancel or ×. Changes are not saved.

optOrdersFilterHelp.message: Filter Outstanding orders by action, currency and product; buy/sell totals per currency; choose which columns to show.

optTransactionsFilterHelp.message: Filter by action, currency and product; buy, sell and net totals per currency, plus fees; choose which columns to show. Covers the page shown.

optNavLinks.message: Orders and Transactions in the sidebar

optNavLinksHelp.message: Two links below Products in DEGIRO's left menu.

optHideSectionsHelp.message: Hide DEGIRO sections by their title.

optHiddenTitles.message: Section titles to hide, one per line (exact title, any case)

optFeedback.description: Link in Settings: opens a new issue on the project's GitHub page

optDisclaimer.message: Unofficial extension — not affiliated with DEGIRO or flatexDEGIRO Bank, and not endorsed or supported by them. DEGIRO is a trademark of its owner.

optLiveHint.message: Changes apply instantly to open DEGIRO tabs.

optTooLong.message: Each title must be at most $1 characters

featPortfolio.description: Feature name in the popup status list

statusMissing.message: Not found — DEGIRO may have changed its page

spread.description: Label in Pricing data and in the product header

exDivLabel.description: Short label before the ex-dividend date

ordersAction.description: Filter group on the Orders page

txNet.description: Transactions page: bought minus sold, per currency

txPageOnly.description: DEGIRO shows more pages of transactions; totals cover only this one

badgeBuy.description: Order badge on the chart, short and upper case

badgeSell.description: Order badge on the chart, short and upper case

badgeNotFound.message: Order not found in the DEGIRO orders list — open it and try again

periodTitle.message: Change over the selected period ($1), from the first to the last point of the chart

portfolioTitle.message: Change in portfolio value over the selected period. Includes deposits and withdrawals, so it is not the same as return.

badgeAria.description: Accessible name of an order badge: $1 = buy/sell, $2 = quantity, $3 = price

badgeMerged.description: Badge on the chart replacing several order badges, $1 = number of orders
